subject: social
title: Land and Water
about: Naming landforms and bodies of water: mountain, hill, valley, island, lake, river, stream, pond, ocean, desert, forest, plain, beach and cave. NC 1.G.1.1: use maps and globes to identify landforms.
tip: Ask him to find one landform in a picture book and name it.

cards.q: What do we call very high land with a peak at the top?
cards.note: A mountain is very high land. The top of a mountain is called the peak.

cards.q: What do we call high land that is smaller than a mountain?
cards.note: A hill is higher than the land around it but lower than a mountain. You can walk up a hill.

cards.q: What do we call the low land between mountains or hills?
cards.note: A valley is low land. Mountains or hills stand on each side of it.

cards.q: What do we call land with water all around it?
cards.note: An island has water on every side. You cross water to get there.

cards.q: What do we call water with land all around it?
cards.note: A lake is a big body of water with land on every side.

cards.q: What do we call a long body of water that flows toward the sea?
cards.note: A river moves. Its water flows downhill toward the sea.

cards.q: What do we call a small river that you can often step across?
cards.note: A stream is a small, narrow river. Streams flow into bigger rivers.

cards.q: What do we call a small body of still water, smaller than a lake?
cards.note: A pond is smaller than a lake. Frogs and ducks like ponds.

cards.q: What do we call the biggest and deepest body of salty water?
cards.note: Oceans cover most of the Earth. The Atlantic Ocean touches North Carolina.

cards.q: What do we call a very dry place that gets little rain?
cards.note: A desert is dry, not always hot. Some deserts are cold.

cards.q: What do we call a big area of land covered with many trees?
cards.note: A forest is full of trees. Many animals live in forests.

cards.q: What do we call flat land with few trees, often covered in grass?
cards.note: A plain is wide, flat land. Farmers often grow food on plains.

cards.q: What do we call the sandy or rocky land right next to the ocean?
cards.note: A beach is where the land meets the sea. The land along the ocean is also called the coast.

cards.q: Which is taller, a hill or a mountain?
cards.note: A mountain is much taller than a hill.

cards.q: Which is bigger, a lake or an ocean?
cards.note: An ocean is far bigger than any lake.

cards.q: Is ocean water salty or fresh?
cards.note: Ocean water is salty. It is not good to drink.

cards.q: Is river water salty or fresh?
cards.note: River water is fresh. Fresh water is not salty.

cards.q: What do we call a hole or tunnel that goes into rock or a hillside?
cards.note: A cave is a hollow space inside rock or a hill. Some caves are very big.
